description: Encode text to RFC 4648 Base32 or decode Base32 back to text. Encoding maps the UTF-8 bytes of the text into 5-bit groups using the alphabet A to Z then 2 to 7, padded to a multiple of 8 characters with equals signs. Decoding tolerates lowercase input and missing padding, and reports characters outside the alphabet as an error. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/base32-encoder/

mode.description: 'encode' turns text into Base32, 'decode' turns Base32 back into text (default encode)

text.description: The text to encode, or the Base32 string to decode

name: hopi_base32_encoder

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Base32 encoder and decoder
